newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Aroma says liquor stocks overstated.
newsitem.headline: Aroma says liquor stocks overstated.

text.p: Aroma Liquor Holdings said on Friday that in annual results to February which were published in May, an error had been discovered in the valuation of bonded liquor stocks.
It said that instead of the stated figure of 1.129 million rand, equivalent to seven cents a share, its liquor stocks should have been stated at 519,000 or 3.2 cents a share.
The company said the error would be corrected when it published its results for the sixteen months to June in August.
